candidate.name: Ignacio Arsuaga
candidate.startAvailability: Available to start immediately upon EAD approval

hero.label: Made for Pomelo Care
hero.headline: I want to bring enterprise employers closer to better maternal care.
hero.subheadline: Pomelo Care is doing something rare: building a clinical model that actually follows high-risk pregnancies through the moments that matter most. I am drawn to the employer sales motion specifically because it sits at the intersection of benefits strategy and real health outcomes. Getting a C-suite benefits leader to say yes here means something far beyond a closed deal.

whyCompany.title: Pomelo targets the gap where maternal mortality risk actually lives
whyCompany.body: Most digital health companies chase the worried-well. Pomelo specifically focuses on high-risk pregnancies, which is where the cost burden and the human stakes are highest for self-insured employers. That focus makes the sales conversation easier to anchor in ROI and harder for a benefits leader to dismiss.

whyCompany.title: First Round backing signals this team is in serious growth mode now
whyCompany.body: The First Round Network perk listed in the benefits is not accidental. It signals Pomelo is operating inside a high-trust, high-velocity startup ecosystem with real institutional conviction behind it. Joining an SDR team at this stage means the playbook is still being written, which is exactly where I want to be early in my career.

whyCompany.title: I have already built cold outreach systems that converted at the enterprise level
whyCompany.body: At Copygen.ai I owned the full top-of-funnel, running LinkedIn sequences and cold calls through HubSpot that contributed to 10 to 12 paying clients from a standing start. At NextAfter I sharpened message testing and digital sequencing inside a B2B consultancy environment. Pomelo's ask, personalized outreach to benefits leaders and C-suite buyers, maps directly onto what I have already done and iterated on.

quote: I have spent the last year learning that the best outbound motion is not about volume, it is about saying the right thing to the right person at a moment they cannot ignore. Maternal health outcomes tied to employer benefits costs is that kind of moment, and I want to be the person opening those conversations for Pomelo.
